types.name: Buy a home
types.producedBy: Home finder wizard (Buy tab of the hero), contact wizard with topic Buy, any buyer registration or home-search sign-up
examples: I want to buy a house in Napa under $750k
Send me homes that match what I am looking for

sources.says: There are five available lead types in BoldTrail:
Type IDs: Buyer (2), Seller (1), Renter (5), Investor (6), Agent (7), Homeowner (8), Landlord (9), Other (-1)
Buyer Registration Forms

types.name: Sell a home
types.producedBy: Sell wizard (Sell tab of the hero, offerType list), contact wizard with topic Sell, a seller lead form
examples: I want to sell my house
Can an agent call me about listing my home

sources.says: Seller Lead Forms
Lead Type identifies the role or intent of a contact in your CRM
like "Sell in 3-6 Months"

types.name: Home value
types.producedBy: Home value wizard (Value tab of the hero, /home_value), contact wizard with topic Home value, a valuation tool that asks for the address
examples: What is my home worth
Give me a free estimate for 12 Oak Street

sources.says: Address Only Leads are created when someone enters their property address in the Home Valuation Tool but does not complete full registration
Homeowners who provide their address automatically receive a home valuation via email.
capture contact information from potential sellers in the immediate area who are just beginning to research the market

types.name: Cash offer
types.producedBy: Sell wizard opened from the Cash tab or a Cash offer link (offerType cash-offer), contact wizard with topic Cash offer
examples: I need to sell fast, will you make a cash offer
Sell my house as is for cash

sources.says: ASAP sellers route to same-day callbacks; flexible sellers enter the follow-up cadence.
Cash buyers pay for motivation, and motivation is exactly what a generic contact form cannot see.

types.name: Showing request
types.producedBy: A 'Schedule Showing' button or showing request form on a listing page: property address, preferred date, whether the visitor has an agent
examples: Can I see 12 Oak Street on Saturday
Book a tour of this home

sources.says: Showing Request Forms
Preferred Showing Date(s)

types.name: Question about a listing
types.producedBy: 'Ask about this home' or 'Request Info' on a listing page (ELEV8 opens the contact wizard with the home's title as the message)
examples: Is this home still available
Does 12 Oak Street have a garage

sources.says: Property Inquiry Forms (specific listing)
"Request Info" button on listings

types.name: Rent a home
types.producedBy: A rental search or rental inquiry form (a visitor who wants to rent, not buy)
examples: I am looking for a 2 bedroom to rent
Do you have rentals in Vallejo

sources.says: There are five available lead types in BoldTrail:

types.name: Rent out a property
types.producedBy: A landlord or owner form: 'I own a property and want to rent it out'
examples: I want to rent out my condo
Can you find a tenant for my house

sources.says: Type IDs: Buyer (2), Seller (1), Renter (5), Investor (6), Agent (7), Homeowner (8), Landlord (9), Other (-1)

types.name: Financing or pre-approval
types.producedBy: The pre-approval question in a buyer form ('Are you pre-approved for a loan?'), the Financing topic of the contact wizard, or a first-time buyer / pre-approval form
examples: How much can I borrow
I need to get pre-approved before I look at homes

sources.says: Already pre-approved buyers route to agents; the rest route to lender partners first.
Are you pre-approved for a mortgage?

types.name: Relocation
types.producedBy: A 'moving to <city>' or relocation guide form, or the first question 'Where are you coming from?' answered with another state
examples: We are moving from Texas for work in Fairfield
Send me your relocation guide

sources.says: creating a relocation guide is a terrific way to give out-of-state buyers all the information they need in one place
The first question out of the gate is: Where are you coming from? What state? What town are you in?
TOFU website content that would resonate with this audience includes area guides, relocation content

types.name: Open house
types.producedBy: The sign-in form at an open house (buyer, agent or neighbor style), reached by QR code or on a tablet
examples: Signing in at the open house on Elm Street
I live next door and want to know what it sells for

sources.says: Leads from open house forms are automatically tagged with Source: Open House
Open House Style for Neighbor

types.name: New construction
types.producedBy: A community inquiry form or a 'request pricing' button on a new-build community page
examples: What are the prices at the new Benicia community
I want to see the floor plans of the new homes

sources.says: Community inquiry forms and “request pricing” buttons should enroll prospects in inventory alerts

types.name: Investing
types.producedBy: A question or form for buyers of investment property, rentals or multi-unit ('I am an investor')
examples: I am looking for a rental property to buy
Do you have multi-unit buildings under $1M

sources.says: Type IDs: Buyer (2), Seller (1), Renter (5), Investor (6), Agent (7), Homeowner (8), Landlord (9), Other (-1)

types.name: Join the team
types.producedBy: A 'Join Our Team' or careers form for agents who want to work with the brokerage or team

merged.note: Lofty 'Homeowner' is a role; a homeowner who asks about value goes to home-value, one who wants to list goes to sell.
An address with no name, email or consent is not a lead the platform can store (capture refuses a lead without consent text, 5-crm.md); it is a Finding.
In BoldTrail and Lofty 'Agent' is the contact's role; the only source that says what produces it is Sierra's recruiting page.
Sierra tags the buyer style Lead Type = Buyer and the neighbor style Lead Type = Seller. We keep one type; the follow-up kind is in the answers.
A contact role for service providers, not something a visitor asks. Not listed.
Real Geeks' buy and sell together. Not a type: a lead that asks both gets the type of its form, and the CRM shows the other as a second form.
